lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: The Museum. Peppa and her family are going to the museum.
lines.zh: 博物馆。佩奇一家要去博物馆。

lines.en: Daddy, what is a museum? It's a place full of interesting things that are very old. Older than you? Yes, even older than me. Ooh! Really old!
lines.zh: 爸爸，博物馆是什么？那是一个装满古老有趣东西的地方。比你还老吗？是的，甚至比我还老。哦！那真是太古老了！

lines.en: There's one room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. I want to see the king and queen's room! And there's another room with a real dinosaur!
lines.zh: 有一个房间里全是很久以前国王和王后的东西。我要去看国王和王后的房间！还有另一个房间里有一只真正的恐龙！

lines.en: Wow! Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 哇！恐龙！

lines.en: Hello, Mummy Pig. Hello, Miss Rabbit. How many tickets, please? Two adults and two children.
lines.zh: 你好，猪妈妈。你好，兔子小姐。请问要几张票？两张成人票和两张儿童票。

lines.en: Dinosaur! And a... dinosaur.
lines.zh: 恐龙！还有一只……恐龙。

lines.en: Peppa wants to see the room full of things that belong to kings and queens from long ago. Wow! But George wants to see the real dinosaur.
lines.zh: 佩奇想去看那个装满很久以前国王和王后用品的房间。哇！可乔治想去看真正的恐龙。

lines.en: Don't worry, George, we will see the dinosaur next.
lines.zh: 别担心，乔治，我们接下来就去看恐龙。

lines.en: Peppa, these are all the things that the queen had a long time ago. This is the queen's special chair, it's called a throne. It's beautiful!
lines.zh: 佩奇，这些都是很久以前王后的东西。这是王后专属的椅子，它叫宝座。真漂亮！

lines.en: This is the queen's dress. It's so pretty!
lines.zh: 这是王后的裙子。真好看！

lines.en: Look, Peppa, this is the queen's golden crown.
lines.zh: 佩奇你看，这是王后的金王冠。

lines.en: Wow! What lovely, lovely things!
lines.zh: 哇！多漂亮、多漂亮的东西啊！

lines.en: Mummy, where is the queen's television? They didn't have television then. No television? But they did have computers? No, they didn't have computers either.
lines.zh: 妈妈，王后的电视在哪儿呢？那时候还没有电视。没有电视？那他们有电脑吧？不，他们也没有电脑。

lines.en: What did they do all day?
lines.zh: 那他们整天都做些什么呢？

lines.en: Mummy, if I was the queen, I would eat as much cake as I wanted. Peppa imagines being a queen.
lines.zh: 妈妈，如果我是王后，我想吃多少蛋糕就吃多少。佩奇在想象自己当王后的样子。

lines.en: Mmm, delicious! Is there anything else you would care for, Queen Peppa? Yes, more cake, please! Of course!
lines.zh: 嗯，真好吃！佩奇王后，您还想要点别的吗？想，再来点蛋糕！遵命！

lines.en: Come on, everyone! Coming, Daddy! Daddy, I'm Queen Peppa! You must bow when you speak to me! Oh, I'm most terribly sorry, Your Royal Highness. And what do you do? I'm your daddy! Hmm, that must be very interesting. Yes, it's very interesting.
lines.zh: 大家快来！来了，爸爸！爸爸，我是佩奇王后！你跟我说话必须鞠躬！哦，万分抱歉，殿下。那您是做什么的呢？我是你爸爸呀！嗯，那一定很有意思吧。是的，非常有意思。

lines.en: And what room is this? This is the dinosaur room.
lines.zh: 那这个是什么房间？这是恐龙展厅。

lines.en: George, this is the dinosaur room! Dinosaur! Where is the dinosaur? He's somewhere in the room. I can't see him, he must be very small. Actually, Peppa, he's very big!
lines.zh: 乔治，这就是恐龙展厅！恐龙！恐龙在哪儿？它就在这个房间里。我怎么看不见它，它一定很小吧。佩奇，其实它非常大！

lines.en: Wow! These are the bones of a real dinosaur!
lines.zh: 哇！这些是真正的恐龙骨头！

lines.en: Dinosaur! George imagines being a big dinosaur.
lines.zh: 恐龙！乔治在想象自己变成一只大恐龙。

lines.en: It's a dinosaur! Help! Help!
lines.zh: 是一只恐龙！救命！救命！

lines.en: The dinosaur room is George's favorite room.
lines.zh: 恐龙展厅是乔治最喜欢的房间。

lines.en: My favorite room is the king and queen's room. And it looks as if Daddy Pig is already in his favorite room. Which room is that, Mummy? The room with the cakes in. Daddy Pig's favorite room is the Museum Café!
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的房间是国王和王后的房间。而且看起来猪爸爸已经在他最喜欢的房间里了。妈妈，那是哪个房间呀？就是放蛋糕的那个房间。猪爸爸最喜欢的房间是博物馆咖啡厅！

lines.en: Come on, tuck in! Oh, yes, this is a very nice room!
lines.zh: 来吧，尽情享用！哦，没错，这真是个非常棒的房间！
